items.title: Nation pledges sustained anti-corruption campaign
items.description: China will maintain a tough stance against corruption and tighten oversight on the exercise of power while improving mechanisms to incentivize and protect officials who take responsibility and act proactively, senior officials said on Friday.

items.title: China discovers huge zircon sand deposit in Xinjiang
items.description: Zirconium is a silvery-gray transition metal with a high melting point, corrosion resistance and a small neutron absorption cross-section, making it a critical material for nuclear reactor fuel rod cladding and aerospace high-temperature alloys.

items.title: Nation pushes for energy dynamism
items.description: China's energy sector investment is maintaining a steady pace while accelerating its structural transition toward high-quality and green development, as the country's installed solar power capacity historically overtakes coal to become its largest single power source, government officials said on Friday.

items.title: HK tightens oversight of building repair work
items.description: The Hong Kong SAR government will launch the first phase of a centralized database for the records of building maintenance projects and professionals in May or June next year, while a new public body will assist local homeowners with the oversight of repair or renovation works from January.

items.title: First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit
items.description: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, East China's Zhejiang province. What will happen when modern technology meets China's ancient town? The summit will gather executives from leading technology companies and developers of open-source large models to discuss how to build a global open-source AI ecosystem. Watch the video to find out!
